title: New York Art Studio

services.name: Art Classes
services.desc: Our live online art classes allow students to study from anywhere in the world while receiving the same high-quality instruction offered in our in-person art classes in NYC. Online students participate in real-time classes with direct instructor feedback, structured lessons, and portfolio-focused guidance. These classes are ideal for students seeking U.S.-based art instruction remotely, including international students who want access to professional art education and portfolio preparation in the USA without relocating. Students receive one-on-one guidance and customized critiques designed to support art portfolio preparation for school admissions, creative development, and long-term
